REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Contract-path classification is bypassable for new or unlisted Factory scripts, allowing governance changes to be accepted as ordinary refactors.
FINDING: critical|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|Factory-contract detection relies on fixed script filenames and docs prefixes; an unlisted script that changes routing, acceptance, or integration authority produces no derived contract area|This permits contract changes to evade high-impact classification and independent Sol/Opus approval.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Replace the filename allowlist with a closed Factory-authority scope or manifest covering all executable governance components, and add a failing fixture for an unlisted/new Factory script.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An accepted change classified as refactor/none modifies scripts/factory-ng-routing-policy.py and carries only a Qwen review; derived_areas remains empty, so relationship validation accepts it.
